authority.source: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
authority.finding: The section directory gives the logical section size; the inner HEADER contains a size, data, CRC and end sentinel. The cited specification does not give semantics to bytes after that validated envelope.

source.description: Locally authored ezdxf 1.4.5 new('R2010') drawing with add_image_def('source.png', (64,64)) and add_image((1,2), (3,4)); ODA File Converter 27.1.0 ACAD2010 DWG, recursion 0, audit 0. All drawings remain scratch-only.

physical_validation.local: A scratch libdxfrw reader extracts exactly the section-directory logical size; independent Python CRC16 verification over bytes 16..824 matches the stored CRC and both sentinel and alternate-size boundary. The native reader previously failed BAD_READ_HEADER because the AC1024 suffix gate was not enabled.
physical_validation.independent: GNU LibreDWG 0.14 trace locates the HEADER compressed page at physical offset 0x33c0 with 1549 compressed bytes starting at offset 13280. Its decompress_R2004_section independently produces a 29696-byte output buffer; the first 1582 bytes exactly match the complete libdxfrw logical section, SHA-256 b53bd89f287fbdd83eddbbc410f3f410a472472b661ea4290a73534517abb506. This is section-byte corroboration, not a suffix meaning or semantic support claim.

implementation: For AC1024 app-maintenance 55 only, permit the previously supported high-size-word-excluded HEADER envelope to have a bounded, unclaimed suffix, subject to correct CRC and both sentinels. The shared HEADER code reports HeaderSectionUnclaimedData; unknown bytes are not decoded or classified, and strict-complete output must still refuse the incomplete source. Other maintenance values and canonical exact envelopes keep their previous behavior.

validation.generated: PASS: 739 unknown bytes; adjacent maintenance values refused; CRC, start/end sentinel and truncation failures rejected with same-good-input retry; nonzero high-size word rejected even after CRC resealing; exact alternate and canonical envelopes remain accepted.
validation.physical: After a coherent library and adapter build, the source import succeeds with 159/159 observed frames published, zero entity/object/CRC failures, 132 opaque frames, and one raster/NOD callback. HEADER diagnostics include compatibility kind 24 (offset 16, expected 821, observed 825) and unclaimed kind 25 (offset 843, expected 843, observed 1582), preserving the 739-byte suffix observation. Strict ASCII and binary output both refuse and preserve their pre-existing destination sentinel; the first reported blocker is IMAGEDEF/reactor capture or immutable-payload correlation, preceding the completeness gate. The result does not attribute the reported output refusal solely to the suffix. The optional source-specific envelope check requires the section hash and verifies maintenance 55, payloadEnd 825, trailerEnd 843 and CRC 0xe6ac.

limitations: The suffix is not proven padding or semantically redundant; strict output and support claims remain unchanged. Only a single ODA source profile has been independently decoded. No DWG or DXF fixture is committed.
